subject: MAP: MercuryVault pilot — technical acceptance & security gate clarifications
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.ai>
To: Ainsley Park <ainsley@mercuryvault.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: MAP: MercuryVault pilot — technical acceptance & security gate checklist

Hi Ainsley,

Thanks again for the demo last week — team feedback was positive and we think Redwood is a good fit for the pilot. Attached is a draft Mutual Action Plan (RV-MAP-draft.xlsx) that maps out the security/compliance gates we discussed so the pilot can move to production. High-level ask: can you confirm owners and realistic target dates for the items below?

Top security gates included in this MAP (requested from MercuryVault):
- SOC 2: provide snapshot of controls and evidence owners (we can accept an SOC 2 Type II snapshot or a SOC 2 bridge letter).
- SIG/CAIQ: completed questionnaire or a partial SIG export + follow-up for open sections.
- DPA: customer redlines (we’ve attached our standard DPA and will accept a tracked-redline back).
- Data residency & retention: choose between US-only or EU residency for pilot, and confirm retention windows for user data and backups (including restore/archival policies).
- Key management: clarify whether you require CMK (bring-your-own-key) via KMS/HSM or Redwood-managed keys.

Suggested timeline (we put tentative dates in the attached MAP):
- SIG baseline returned: 2026-12-21 — assigned to MercuryVault security
- DPA redline returned: 2026-12-22 — assigned to MercuryVault legal
- SOC 2 evidence snapshot: 2026-12-23 — assigned to MercuryVault audit owner
- Final acceptance decision (pilot -> production): 2027-01-06

Attachments: RV-MAP-draft.xlsx

If those dates are tight, point us at the delivery windows you need and we’ll re-sequence the MAP accordingly. I’ve cc’d Karthik (your AE) and Kimberly from our security team to help answer technical questions.

Next step: if it helps, we can do a short 30-minute intake call tomorrow to walk the MAP and owners.

Thanks,
Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
sofIA@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Ainsley Park <ainsley@mercuryvault.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.ai>
Cc: MercuryVault Legal <legal@mercuryvault.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Dec 2026 11:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP: MercuryVault pilot — technical acceptance & security gate checklist

Thanks, Sofia — this is helpful. A few clarifying items from our side before we lock dates: 

1) Data residency: we are likely to require EU residency for customer data for the pilot (user data at rest). Can Redwood support EU-region-only hosting for the pilot (data processed and stored in eu-west-1)? If not we need to update the MAP.

2) KMS: we prefer customer-managed keys for production. For the pilot, can we use Redwood-managed keys if we confirm a migration path to CMK later? Please confirm whether you support KMS integrations (AWS KMS/Dedicated HSM) and what the timing would be.

3) Backups & deletion: our compliance team requires an explicit deletion SLA for backups (we need confirmation of the maximum retention window and deletion process for backup snapshots).

4) SOC 2 timing: we have an internal audit on 2026-12-29 — our legal/audit team would like SOC 2 evidence earlier than your suggested 12/23 date if possible. Is there a SOC 2 snapshot you can share sooner?

We’ve compiled our SIG questions in the attached PDF to make it easier for your security team to respond. Also sending to legal to coordinate the DPA redline.

Attachment: MercuryVault-SIG-questions.pdf

Best,
Ainsley Park
Head of Platform Risk, MercuryVault
ainsley@mercuryvault.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Ainsley Park <ainsley@mercuryvault.com>
Cc: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Dec 2026 14:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP: MercuryVault pilot — technical acceptance & security gate checklist

Appreciate the quick context, Ainsley — happy to align. Short answers for now:

- EU residency: yes, Redwood can run the pilot using eu-west-1. I’ll mark the MAP as EU residency option and update the hosting row.
- KMS: pilot can use Redwood-managed keys; we support migration to customer-managed keys (AWS KMS) prior to production cutover. Migration is typically a 2–3 week ops task once both teams agree on key escrow/rotation windows.
- Backups: default snapshot retention is 30 days; we can shorten to 7 days for the pilot if required. Permanent archival policies are configurable. We will provide a backup deletion playbook.
- SOC 2 snapshot: I’ll check with Kimberly and see if we can surface the most recent SOC 2 snapshot earlier this week.

Can we schedule a 30-minute call Thursday 12/16 at 10:00am PT to walk owners and agree on updated MAP dates?

Thanks,
Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0188

On Wed, Dec 15, 2026 at 11:45 AM Ainsley Park <ainsley@mercuryvault.com> wrote:
> Thanks, Sofia — this is helpful. A few clarifying items from our side before we lock dates: ...

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
To: Ainsley Park <ainsley@mercuryvault.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 17 Dec 2026 09:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP: MercuryVault pilot — technical acceptance & security gate checklist

Hi Ainsley — thanks for the questions. I pulled the relevant items together below and attached the SOC 2 snapshot for your audit team.

SOC 2
- We can provide a redacted SOC 2 Type II report (most recent reporting period) and a controls matrix. See attached SOC2-2026-snapshot.pdf.
- If you need a bridge letter or additional control evidence, tell us which control IDs and we’ll pull the supporting artifacts from our evidence repository.

SIG/CAIQ
- We ran an export and completed ~80% of the SIG answers; we’ll attach the partial export and create a focused Q&A for the 20% open items (owner: Kimberly@redwood.ai). Expect the partial export + answers by 2026-12-18.

DPA
- Received your legal team’s note. We reviewed the redline and made counter-comments in DPA-redline.docx. Main items called out: liability cap carveouts and EU data processing addendum wording. If MercuryVault legal can return a single consolidated redline, we can accept or escalate to exec legal for one-last pass.

KMS & Data residency
- We support both Redwood-managed keys and integration with AWS KMS for CMK. Pilot migration path documented: initial pilot on Redwood keys, pre-production migration to CMK with a one-week freeze for key rotation and validation.
- EU residency: Redwood can restrict processing/storage to eu-west-1 for the pilot. We will update the MAP hosting row to reflect EU-only for MercuryVault.

Backups & deletion
- Default retention: 30 days. We can configure 7-day retention for pilot. Backup snapshots are subject to secure deletion; deletion SLA for backups is 48–72 hours after a verified deletion request (we will provide an audit trail).

Proposed updated acceptance milestones (per MAP):
- SIG partial export + answers: 2026-12-18 (owner: Kimberly)
- DPA consolidated redline returned: 2026-12-20 (owner: MercuryVault legal)
- SOC 2 snapshot delivered: 2026-12-18 (attached)
- Final go/no-go: 2026-12-22 (we can move to 12/29 if you need the extra audit buffer)

Attachments: SOC2-2026-snapshot.pdf, DPA-redline.docx

If the internal audit on 12/29 is immovable, we recommend bumping the MAP final decision to 2026-12-29 so your audit kicks off with all artifacts in-hand. Otherwise, we can aim for the 12/22 decision and escalate any outstanding items.

Kimberly Park
Head of Security, Redwood Inference
kimberly@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0147

From: Ainsley Park <ainsley@mercuryvault.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 20 Dec 2026 16:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP: MercuryVault pilot — technical acceptance & security gate checklist

Thanks Kimberly — this is great and addresses the majority of our asks.

We’ll do the following on our side:
- Legal will consolidate a single DPA redline and return by 2026-12-20 (target).
- Security will review SOC2-2026-snapshot.pdf and SIG partial export on 12/21 and confirm any remaining control evidence requests by 12/22.
- We confirm EU residency for the pilot (eu-west-1) and accept the temporary Redwood-managed keys for pilot with the documented migration to CMK prior to production.

If legal returns the DPA redline as planned, please send the DocuSign link for the agreed DPA and we’ll loop in signatories. Also please attach the backup deletion playbook referenced so we can align internal retention controls.

Acknowledged and thanks for the fast turnaround — moving MAP -> acceptance decision on track.

Best,
Ainsley
Head of Platform Risk, MercuryVault
ainsley@mercuryvault.com
